lines.t: How can you change one heart or hand,
By walking close where they now stand?
Can you teach the blind to see the sun,
Or wake the deaf when all is done?
Can you heal the tongue that’s still and numb?
Beloved, I shall teach them one by one.
And if they turn away, I’ll call their name,
Rebuke their pride, yet love the same.
Beloved, walk the narrow way,
Don’t be yoked where shadows stay.
Light and dark will never blend,
Truth will hold you till the end.
Beloved, take the road that’s true,
You shall go where I send you.
What peace has truth with hearts of guile?
What joy with sorrow reconciled?
What song can light and shadow sing?
Only love makes mercy ring.
Kick not your foot against the stone,
You’ll limp away but not alone.
Beloved, walk the narrow way,
Don’t be yoked where shadows stay.
Light and dark will never blend,
Truth will hold you till the end.
Beloved, take the road that’s true,
You shall go where I send you.
Lift your eyes to skies of grace,
Feel the sun upon your face.
Every step, I go with you,
Every breath, your heart made new.
Beloved, walk with faith anew,
Let the morning carry you.
Light will shine and lead you through,
You shall go where I send you.
Yeah, you shall go where I send you.
